home.heading: Welcome to {school}
home.intro: The school website is being set up. Please check back soon.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

auth.loginIntro: Use the email or mobile number your school gave you.
auth.invalidCredentials: Wrong email, mobile number or password.
auth.noAccess: Your account has no access. Please contact the school office.
auth.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.linkSent: If an account exists for that email, we have sent a reset link. Check your inbox.
auth.changeIntro: For your security, choose a new password before you continue.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

errors.emailOrPhone: Enter an email or an 11-digit mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX).
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.passwordSame: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.httpsUrl: Enter a full link starting with https://
errors.mapEmbed: Use a Google Maps embed link (https://www.google.com/maps/embed?…).
errors.year: Enter a year between 1800 and this year.
errors.logoSize: The logo must be at most 1 MB.
errors.logoType: The logo must be PNG, JPG or WebP.
errors.uploadFailed: The logo could not be uploaded. Please try again.
errors.colorContrast: This colour is too light for text on white. Choose a darker one (contrast at least 4.5:1).

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this page
forbidden.body: This page belongs to a different role. If you think this is a mistake, contact the school office.

settings.title: School settings
settings.intro: These details appear on the website and on printed documents.
settings.saved: Settings saved. The website now shows the changes.
settings.failed: Settings could not be saved. Check the highlighted fields.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 1 MB. Leave empty to keep the current logo.
